ratnik_emr_camo.notes: EMR ("tsifra") summer: light grey-green ground with dark-green, brown and black pixel clusters forming larger deforming blobs (Flecktarn-like micro/macro structure). Proportions used: ground ~45%, green 28%, brown 27% (black ~9% inside the dark clusters).

mm14_camo.notes: MM-14: five-tone digital pattern (light beige, light green, swamp green, grey-green, dark grey); slightly horizontally elongated shapes.

multicam.notes: UA plate carriers / helmet covers / some tops; organic 6-tone pattern, procedural approximation.

6b46_plate_carrier.notes: Ratnik lightweight plate carrier: front/back plate bags (Granit-type plates), cummerbund, padded shoulder straps, MOLLE, drag handle. Modelled: plate bags ~300 x 336 mm front / 310 x 344 mm back, 22-26 mm thick with plate bulge and shooter's-cut corners; cummerbund 180 mm; 6Sh117-style pouches: 3 flapped double AK mag pouches (85x155x62 mm, Fastex), radio pouch (R-187 style radio + antenna), grenade pouches, IFAK, hydration and dump pouch.

ua_plate_carrier.notes: JPC-style: slimmer plate bags (280 x 316 mm), integrated open-top triple mag shingle with visible AK mag bases, admin pouch with UA flag patch, CAT tourniquet, radio on the cummerbund, IFAK, grenade pouch; MultiCam + coyote webbing.

helmets.RU helmet_B: 6B47 with EMR cover, band and goggles on the brow

references.tape_bands: Identification tape wrapped twice around the upper arms (~50 mm wide, ~120 mm below the shoulder joint) and around the thighs; RU white (alt red), UA yellow. Separate meshes using material `tape` (extras.recolourable) so the game can recolour them.

assault_kit.RU: 6B45 in assault configuration: shoulder/upper-arm protectors, groin protector, side plates, neck collar; 6B47 with NVG mount + headset or Altyn-style heavy visorless helmet; balaclavas on some; grenade pouches + 6Sh117 assault pouches, IFAK, dump pouch; knee + elbow pads, assault pack with radio, gloves

weapons.ak74m: AK-74M (6P20) 943 mm: plum polymer furniture, ribbed dust cover, stamped receiver with trunnion rivets and mag-well dimples, side rail, tangent rear sight, 90-deg gas block with vented gas tube, cleaning rod, AK-74 two-chamber brake, side-folding solid stock, 5.45 mm 30-rd curved mag (separate `magazine` node), 2-point sling

weapons.pkm: PKM 1190 mm: stamped receiver, ribbed feed cover + tray, fluted barrel, gas cylinder under the barrel, folded bipod, barrel carry handle, slotted flash hider, skeleton stock, 100-rd box with belt feeding the tray, sling

weapons.texturing: one PBR atlas per weapon (base colour / ORM / tangent normal, JPEG), procedural with edge wear, cavity grime, stamped/moulded detail and stencils in the normal + colour maps; ~1100-1400 px/m on rifles

skeleton.rig: MakeHuman cmu_mb (CMU-BVH compatible names); joint nodes carry identity rest rotations (world-aligned frames); skins use inverse bind = translate(-joint).

sockets.weapon_socket: child of RightHand: parent a weapon GLB (origin = pistol grip, +Z muzzle) with identity transform; matches all rifle-hold clips
sockets.weapon_socket_L: child of LeftHand: rifle carried by the handguard (grip_L in the palm) - use during throw_grenade
sockets.weapon_socket_back: child of Spine1: slung rifle diagonally on the back, muzzle up over the right shoulder (RPG gunner, drag_wounded, wounded clips)
sockets.mag_socket_L: child of LeftHand: attach ak74m `magazine` node during reloads
sockets.aim: child of Head at the eye midpoint (eye height)
sockets.aim_eye_R: child of Head at the right eye (sighting eye)
sockets.drag_handle: child of Spine1 at the vest drag handle (top of the back plate): contact point of being_dragged / drag_wounded

soldier_ru.notes: body_A/B/C are alternative variants (one visible at a time; A default). hands vs gloves are alternatives. helmet_A/helmet_B alternatives. backpack, legband_L, kneepads, pouches_back off by default. Gear is skinned to the shared skeleton (vest/pouches to Hips..Spine1/clavicles, helmet rigid to Head, kneepads rigid to *Leg, tape bands follow the sleeve weights). Vertex colours (COLOR_0) on gear carry baked ambient occlusion.
soldier_ru.combo_notes: Pre-combined presets for rendering (2 draw calls per soldier): `<name>` = ONE SkinnedMesh / ONE primitive with material soldier_atlas_ru (2048^2 atlas: base colour JPEG, normal PNG, ORM PNG [R=AO 1, G=roughness, B=metalness]) merging every visible part (body/head/eyes, hands or gloves, boots, vest, pouches, helmet, backpack, kneepads, assault armour, headset, balaclava); `<name>_tape` = the preset's arm/leg bands with the recolourable `tape` material; `<name>_LOD1` / `<name>_tape_LOD1` ~28% / ~40%. Same skeleton/skin as the per-part nodes, so all sockets keep working. extras.combo = true, hidden by default (show exactly one preset + its _tape and hide all per-part nodes). Camouflage is identical to the per-part materials: the uniform is copied texel-for-texel (90-degree turns only) at ~1.0 mm/texel (EMR / MM-14 pixels stay 3.5-6 texels wide), tiling gear camo is mapped into one wrap-padded repeat region per material at the same pattern scale (gear triangles never cross a repeat: components are shifted by whole tiles), vertex colours keep the baked AO. Balaclava presets drop the covered face triangles.
soldier_ru.tape_alt_material: tape (white #e9e9e4); for red tape set tape colour to #b01e1e (tape_red); materials named `tape` are recolourable

soldier_anims.contents: skeleton + sockets + clips only (no meshes); tracks: Hips translation + rotation of all 31 joints, 30 fps, linear
soldier_anims.in_place: loops have horizontal root motion stripped (Hips keeps vertical bob); deaths and dismount_jump keep root motion and end at rest
soldier_anims.time_scaling: ground_speed_mps is the clip's natural speed; the game time-scales by speed / ground_speed_mps. walk_rifle is a native 1.47 m/s tactical walk (CMU 07_01, pelvis lowered, soft knees, rifle at low ready; game 1.55 m/s = x1.06) and run_rifle a native 4.17 m/s weighty combat run (CMU 16_45, bent knees, 12 deg lean, rifle at port; game 4.2 m/s = x1.01). The planted foot is pinned to the ground sliding back at exactly ground_speed_mps, so there is no foot sliding at those speeds.

rifle_fire.clips: fire_stand / fire_crouch / fire_prone / fire_peek_left / fire_peek_right / fire_peek_crouch_left / fire_peek_crouch_right
rifle_fire.cycle: each clip is ONE shot (0.133 s, 5 frames): event shot at 0.0 (muzzle flash / tracer / sound), peak kick at 0.033 s (butt drives the shoulder ~2 cm back, muzzle climbs ~3 deg pivoting at the butt, chest and cheek absorb), recovered by 0.133 s. First and last frame == the matching aim pose (aim_stand / aim_crouch / aim_prone / peek_* frame 0), so the clip loops seamlessly during a burst (one recoil cycle per loop) and cross-fades back into the aim clip.

peeks.clips: peek_left / peek_right (standing), peek_crouch_left / peek_crouch_right (kneeling), 2 s loops
peeks.geometry: leaning out around a wall corner while aiming straight ahead (+Z): trunk rolled 22-28 deg about the aim axis to the named side (the soldier's own left / right), weight on that leg, feet / knee planted, rifle on the right shoulder canted 11-12 deg (right peeks) / 32-40 deg (left peeks: the cheek stays on the stock), right eye on the sight line, butt in the shoulder pocket (< 1.5 cm). The head sits 0.23-0.36 m to the lean side of the root (events.head_out_m): with the corner edge ~0.15 m to the lean side of the root, head and rifle are past the edge and the far shoulder / hip stay behind it.

cover.cover_duck: deep squat tight behind a low wall / window sill in front (+Z, wall face ~0.42 m ahead of the root), head below a 0.9-1.0 m parapet (see events.head_top_m), rifle vertical and close, flinches (events.flinch); 3 s loop
cover.pinned_prone: flat prone, face down, left forearm over the helmet, rifle lying on its side beside the body (still in weapon_socket), flinches (events.flinch); 3 s loop

launchers.socket: weapon_socket (identity) for both rpg22.glb and rpg7.glb in aim_launcher / aim_launcher_kneel / fire_launcher
launchers.authored_for: RPG-22: right eye on the rear-sight line, tube underside on the right trapezius, right hand on the tube under the firing housing (= launcher origin), left palm under the front tube (rpg22 grip_L).

rpg7_offset.note: RPG-7 also fits with identity: its tube axis is 7 mm higher and its PGO-7 eyepiece sits 5 cm left / 4 cm below the eye (head over the tube instead of beside it). For an exact PGO-7 sight picture offset the launcher by [-0.051, 0.042, 0.0] (launcher local), at the cost of a 4 cm gap above the shoulder.

launchers.sequence: launcher_raise[_kneel] (0.8 s, plays once: ready stance with the launcher carried low in both hands -> on the right shoulder; last frame == aim_launcher[_kneel] frame 0) -> aim_launcher[_kneel] (loop) -> fire_launcher[_kneel] (1.0 s, plays once from the aim pose: shot / backblast at 0.05 s, tube jump, head flinch, standing half step back; recoil done by ~0.45 s, then the head comes off the sight and the empty tube dips). Attach rpg22.glb to weapon_socket when the raise starts.

riding.frame: ride_sit_edge / ride_sit_deck / ride_aim: root = ride_seat_N empty (point on the sitting surface under the pelvis), +Z = seat facing; Hips joint 0.118 m above and 0.035 m behind the seat point; place the soldier root exactly on the seat empty (position + heading), no ground snapping.
riding.edge: thighs along +Z, knees ~0.42 m out, shins angled ~30 deg outward (clears the BTR's sloped upper hull), rifle across the lap
riding.deck: knees up, feet flat on the deck ~0.47 m ahead, rifle upright between the knees, butt on the deck
riding.dismount_jump: root on the ground at the landing point; the clip starts with the seat point at (0, 1.8, -1.6) relative to it (game: landing = seat + 1.6 m outward, seat ~1.8 m high); vertical and horizontal root motion kept; touchdown 0.84 s

medical.drag: drag_wounded (dragger) and being_dragged (casualty) share a 2.5 s loop. Casualty root = dragger root + 1.0 m along the dragger facing, casualty heading = dragger heading + 180 deg (head towards the dragger). Contact point = socket drag_handle (Spine1) at (0, 0.50, 0.42) in the casualty frame = (0, 0.50, 0.58) in the dragger frame (both hands).
medical.treat_wounded: medic kneels; the casualty (wounded_ground / wounded_sit) lies ~0.55 m in front of the medic root
medical.wounded_sit: back against a wall plane 0.30 m behind the root (-Z)

soldier_anims.sources: CMU mocap: walk 07_01, run 16_45, crouch walk 136_09, limp 77_19, drag 81_08 (legs), death_back 90_18, throw 113_24. Arms of all rifle clips are IK-solved onto the AK grips (right hand = weapon_socket, left hand = grip_L) then baked. Aim clips: authored cheek-weld head posture, gun on the sight line through the right eye, chest/clavicle solved to bring the butt to the shoulder pocket.

death_back.notes: CMU 90_18 0.35-3.2s, root motion kept, ends at rest; game should drop/detach the weapon at start

drag_wounded.notes: CMU 81_08 legs (walking backwards), bent over, both hands on the casualty drag handle at [0.0, 0.5, 0.58] (own root frame); casualty root 1.0 m ahead (+Z) playing being_dragged; rifle slung on back; cycle (0, 75)

fire_stand.notes: one-shot recoil cycle 0.133 s (5 frames): report/muzzle flash at t=0 with the rifle on the aim line, peak kick at 0.033 s (muzzle +3.0 deg, butt/shoulder 2.5 cm back, chest & cheek absorb), recovered at 0.133 s; first/last frame == aim_stand pose, so it loops seamlessly for bursts (one shot per loop, ~7.5 shots/s at timeScale 1; raise timeScale for a faster cyclic rate) and blends back into the aim clip; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

reload_stand.notes: standing magazine change from/to the aim pose: rifle into the workspace (canted, in front of the chest), left hand grabs the mag (thumb on the release) and rocks it out (mag_out 0.70 s: attach the magazine to mag_socket_L preserving its world transform, e.g. THREE Object3D.attach), down to the front pouch (1.04-1.26 s) and back, front lug in and rocked home (mag_in 1.80 s: the left palm is at the same rifle-relative pose as at mag_out, so restoring the home transform is seamless; rifle dips with the slap), racks the charging handle over the top (2.05-2.2 s), back on the shoulder at 2.55 s; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

reload_crouch.notes: kneeling magazine change from/to the aim pose: rifle into the workspace (canted, in front of the chest), left hand grabs the mag (thumb on the release) and rocks it out (mag_out 0.70 s: attach the magazine to mag_socket_L preserving its world transform, e.g. THREE Object3D.attach), down to the front pouch (1.04-1.26 s) and back, front lug in and rocked home (mag_in 1.80 s: the left palm is at the same rifle-relative pose as at mag_out, so restoring the home transform is seamless; rifle dips with the slap), racks the charging handle over the top (2.05-2.2 s), back on the shoulder at 2.55 s; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

cover_duck.notes: deep squat tight behind a low wall / sill in front (+Z, face of the wall ~0.42 m ahead of the root), back rounded, head ducked (helmet top <= 0.94 m, i.e. under a ~0.9-1.0 m parapet), rifle vertical and close (muzzle up beside the head), flinches at 0.55 s and 2.0 s, fast breathing + tremor; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

pinned_prone.notes: pinned in the open: flat on the belly, face down (turned right), left forearm over the back of the helmet, right hand on the rifle lying on its side beside the body (weapon_socket as usual), flinches at 0.8 s and 2.15 s, fast breathing; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

launcher_raise.notes: standing RPG-22 raise (0.8 s): from the ready stance with the extended launcher carried low in both hands (right hand = weapon_socket on the grip, left palm under the front tube), left foot steps 10 cm forward into the launcher stance; the tube swings up the right side and over the shoulder (0.15-0.6 s), settles onto the trapezius, cheek comes down to the sight last; last frame == aim_launcher frame 0; attach rpg22.glb to weapon_socket at t=0 and hide the rifle; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

fire_launcher.notes: standing RPG-22 shot from aim_launcher frame 0: brief brace, rocket leaves at 0.05 s (muzzle flash + backblast from the rear empty), tube jumps ~6 deg pivoting on the shoulder, head flinches up/away from the tube, chest rocks back; rear (right) foot takes an 8 cm half step back (0.09-0.29 s); settled by ~0.45 s, then the head comes off the sight and the empty tube dips (0.55-0.95 s) ready to be discarded; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

launcher_raise_kneel.notes: kneeling RPG-22 raise (0.8 s): from the ready stance with the extended launcher carried low in both hands (right hand = weapon_socket on the grip, left palm under the front tube); the tube swings up the right side and over the shoulder (0.15-0.6 s), settles onto the trapezius, cheek comes down to the sight last; last frame == aim_launcher_kneel frame 0; attach rpg22.glb to weapon_socket at t=0 and hide the rifle; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

fire_launcher_kneel.notes: kneeling RPG-22 shot from aim_launcher_kneel frame 0: brief brace, rocket leaves at 0.05 s (muzzle flash + backblast from the rear empty), tube jumps ~6 deg pivoting on the shoulder, head flinches up/away from the tube, chest rocks back over the kneeling knee; settled by ~0.45 s, then the head comes off the sight and the empty tube dips (0.55-0.95 s) ready to be discarded; ik err {'R': 0.0, 'L': 0.0}

deviations: Uniform is part of each body_X SkinnedMesh (head + eyes + uniform); boots are a separate always-on node `boots`; `gloves` is an alternative to `hands`.
Extra nodes beyond the contract: gloves, boots, kneepads, legband_L, pouches_front/side/back split, helmet_B per faction, *_LOD1 for every mesh node.
Extra sockets: weapon_socket_L, mag_socket_L, aim_eye_R. AK-74M magazine is a separate node.
tape_red is not a separate material in the GLB (unused glTF materials are dropped by loaders); recolour `tape` instead (value given above).
throw_grenade needs the rifle moved to weapon_socket_L; wounded/drag/death clips expect the game to drop or sling the rifle.
Full kit (both legbands + kneepads + backpack + pouches_back) slightly exceeds 25k tris; default configuration is listed in default_config_tris.
Assault presets carry ~28-30k tris (armour + 4 extra pouch groups + headset/balaclava); use their _LOD1 (~8k) beyond close range.
GLBs use KHR_mesh_quantization (required) for int8 normals; weights are normalized u8, atlas UVs normalized u16 (all native in three.js GLTFLoader).
